questions_for_user: Legal: the terms line names the 'Submit' button. Change it to 'Create account' when the button changes?
Is the client told when a booking is deleted? If yes, add it to the dialog body.
Help: /help/ had 240 views of the 404 page and the signup page links to it. Is there a help page to link?
Refund: searched, with no page yet. Add a page, or answer it on Pricing?
Gift card: searched, not offered. No label change; consider a line on Pricing saying so.
The deposit tooltip says the rest is paid at the booked time. Confirm that's how payment works.
Smart reminders: the old page was /features/sms-reminders/ and the tooltip says multi-channel. Confirm reminders go by text and email before the new line ships.
unknowns: Clarity reports by page, not by element: the elements named on /pricing/ and /signup/ come from the screenshot and the page reader.
Logged-in screens can't be read by the page reader; app strings come from the pasted locale file only, with no behaviour data.
The page holds one shared error for every field, so the new per-field errors are written from the fields' rules; check them against the form's real validation.
Whether the check-in name field is required: if it is, it needs an empty error like the signup fields.
